scopeLabel: All 9 main and 5 SI pages read in text and actual page images. Three CdS liquid–gas synthesis temperatures, gas generation, TiO2/FTO support preparation, three CdS sensitizations, three CdSe co-sensitizations, separately qualified ZnS passivation, electrolyte and cathode support, and six photovoltaic devices. Measurement contexts preserve source sample labels but do not invent exact physical batch identity. Source ambiguities and incomplete protocols remain explicit. No external cited procedure is reconstructed.

availability.morphology_illustration: Three qualified TEM outline schematics; all other contexts remain nongeometric. Optional bulk CdS cells are independent references only for powder XRD contexts.

bindings.caption: Place about 50 µm Scotch tape at sides of photoanode. Tape is the source-reported spacer; no masking aperture, substrate thickness or seal geometry invented. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Add a drop of sodium polysulfide electrolyte. No drop volume reported. §2.5 identifies aqueous electrolyte for impedance; solvent is not independently restated in this sandwich assembly paragraph. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Sandwich with nominal Cu2S/brass dark cathode. Typical active area5×5mm. Scheme1 CuxS andFTO/ITO labels remain qualified; actual substrate method uses FTO. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

Measure J–V under 1 Sun AM1.5G. Oriel class3A solar simulator and Keithley2420 source meter; AM1.5G. At least5different cells per source sample, not5synthesis runs; no statistical error bars inferred. Apparatus dimensions, liquid level and spatial layout are schematic, not measured source geometry.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
